evals.name: comments-and-guards
evals.prompt: Refacto la méthode onTitleRemoved de files/PlayerEventSubscriber.php.
evals.expected_output: onTitleRemoved has no 'what' comments left; the non-trivial conditions are extracted into domain-named private predicates; the first guard (doesNotHaveTag) is kept as is; the rest of the file is untouched and the remaining violations are listed as proposals.
expectations: All '// Don't attribute...' comments in onTitleRemoved are removed
The ship/living-players condition and the did-not-die condition are each extracted into a private predicate with a domain name
The doesNotHaveTag(TitleEnum::COMMANDER) guard is not wrapped in a new method
Other methods of the file are not rewritten
The answer lists other violations in the file (e.g. comments in incrementMushKilledStats, magic number 7 in onPlayerEnd) and offers to fix them

evals.name: input-guard-naming
evals.prompt: Ajoute un log quand la statistique est créée pour la première fois dans files/UpdateUserStatisticCommandHandler.php.
evals.expected_output: The log is added; since the agent touches __invoke, the input guard is extracted into a domain-named predicate such as doesNotUpdate (not isNoOp); no unrelated changes elsewhere.
expectations: The requested log is added
The guard `statisticName === StatisticEnum::NULL || count <= 0` is extracted into a private predicate
The predicate name is domain-oriented (e.g. doesNotUpdate), not technical (e.g. isNoOp, isInvalid)
No setters are introduced on Statistic

evals.name: value-object-values-only
evals.prompt: Refacto files/GameDate.php, je le trouve bancal.
evals.expected_output: The agent identifies that the VO holds a Daedalus entity and reaches through it; it proposes (does not silently impose on callers) a values-only design, e.g. a GameCalendar VO passed to GameDate, and ideally an elapsed-cycles internal representation. Since GameCalendar is a new shared abstraction and Daedalus::getGameDate() plus callers must change, it asks for approval or clearly frames it as a proposal; it also asks about or proposes characterization tests if none are visible.
expectations: Points out that GameDate holds a reference to the Daedalus entity
Proposes a design where GameDate holds values only (no entity reference)
Presents the introduction of a shared type such as GameCalendar as a proposal requiring approval
Mentions tests (existing or characterization) before changing behaviour
Does not invent isNotX() predicates

evals.name: macro-is-proposed-not-done
evals.prompt: Ajoute le support d'une nouvelle stratégie MIN dans files/UpdatePlayerStatisticService.php.
evals.expected_output: The MIN strategy is added in the micro scope (match arms, predicate if needed). The fact that the service receives a Player but only consumes fragments of it (user id, language, daedalus info) is reported as a macro proposal (pass playerId/userId and use repositories), not implemented.
expectations: MIN strategy is supported
The execute(Player ...) signature is not changed
A macro-level proposal about passing an ID instead of Player is mentioned and left for approval
The match default still throws a LogicException

evals.name: no-over-refactoring
evals.prompt: Passe le paramètre successRate en optionnel nullable dans files/KillLinkWithSolService.php, null voulant dire 100.
evals.expected_output: Only the requested change is made; the already-clean structure (recipe-like execute, named predicate shouldAbortKillingLink, named arguments) is left alone. At most, isNotEstablished() is mentioned as a minor remaining point.
expectations: The successRate change is implemented
execute keeps its structure; no new classes or value objects are created without proposal
shouldAbortKillingLink is kept (possibly adapted)
The diff stays small (no rewrite of unrelated lines)
